│                       │      │                   XSD-validated document 
│                       │      ├ Description     : A flaw was found in libxml2. This vulnerability occurs when
│                       │      │                   the library processes a specially crafted XML Schema
│                       │      │                   Definition (XSD) validated document that includes an
│                       │      │                   internal entity reference. An attacker could exploit this by
│                       │      │                    providing a malicious document, leading to a type confusion
│                       │      │                    error that causes the application to crash. This results in
│                       │      │                    a denial of service (DoS), making the affected system or
│                       │      │                   application unavailable.

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Improve C2 loop transformations (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1 and  27. Difficult to exploit
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                    Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of
│                       │      │                   Oracle Java SE accessible data as well as  unauthorized read
│                       │      │                    access to a subset of Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data
│                       │      │                   to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such
│                       │      │                   as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.8
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance SASL Authentication (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Security). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1,
│                       │      │                   25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and 
│                       │      │                   21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1.
│                       │      │                   Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated
│                       │      │                   attacker with network access via multiple protocols to
│                       │      │                   compromise Oracle Java SE.  Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or
│                       │      │                   delete access to some of Oracle Java SE accessible data as
│                       │      │                   well as  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java
│                       │      │                    SE accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be
│                       │      │                   exploited by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g.,
│                       │      │                   through a web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.8
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JAXP).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,

│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.

│                       │      │                   unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service
│                       │      │                   (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,

│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance XPath Expressions (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JAXP).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or complete access to all Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited
│                       │      │                   by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a
│                       │      │                   web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.9
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance HTTP Client (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Networking). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily exploitable
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                    Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of
│                       │      │                   Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can
│                       │      │                    be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,
│                       │      │                   e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run
│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and
│                       │      │                    rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score
│                       │      │                   5.3 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance TLS handshakes (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: JSSE). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1,
│                       │      │                   25.0.4.1; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily
│                       │      │                   exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker
│                       │      │                   with network access via TLS to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in
│                       │      │                   unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service
│                       │      │                   (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                   can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,
│                       │      │                   e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run
│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and
│                       │      │                    rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score
│                       │      │                   5.3 (Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance jstatd (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Serviceability).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update,
│                       │      │                   insert or delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data as well as  unauthorized read access to a
│                       │      │                   subset of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 4.8 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).

│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Libraries). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to
│                       │      │                   exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with
│                       │      │                   logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Java SE executes to
│                       │      │                    compromise Oracle Java SE.  Successful attacks require
│                       │      │                   human interaction from a person other than the attacker.
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or all Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 4.7 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).

│                       │      │                   23acf99bf8e 
│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance JShell (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JDK tools).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with logon to the infrastructure
│                       │      │                   where Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                    Enterprise Edition executes to compromise Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks require human interaction from a person
│                       │      │                   other than the attacker. Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion
│                       │      │                    or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java
│                       │      │                   SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability applies to
│                       │      │                    Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability does not apply to Java deployments, typically
│                       │      │                   in servers, that load and run only trusted code (e.g., code
│                       │      │                   installed by an administrator). CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.7
│                       │      │                   (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance CORBA (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component:
│                       │      │                   CORBA).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle
│                       │      │                   Java SE: 8u503 and  8u503-perf; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability
│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a
│                       │      │                   partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                   can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a
│                       │      │                   web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Availability impacts).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance GIF loading (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle JavaFX, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product
│                       │      │                   of Oracle Java SE (component: ImageIO).  Supported versions
│                       │      │                   that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf,
│                       │      │                   11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle
│                       │      │                   JavaFX: 21.0.12, 25.0.4, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle JavaFX,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in
│                       │      │                   unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service
│                       │      │                   (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE, Oracle JavaFX, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Improve HTTP headers (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Lightweight HTTP Server).  Supported versions
│                       │      │                   that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf,
│                       │      │                   11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily exploitable
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of
│                       │      │                   Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                    can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a
│                       │      │                   web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Integrity impacts).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance krb5 tokens (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JGSS).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;    Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1;   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability
│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data
│                       │      │                   to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such
│                       │      │                   as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.9 (Integrity
│                       │      │                    impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance krb5 client (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JGSS).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   require human interaction from a person other than the
│                       │      │                   attacker. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can
│                       │      │                   result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete
│                       │      │                   access to all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                    GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                   clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. This vulnerability does not apply
│                       │      │                    to Java deployments, typically in servers, that load and
│                       │      │                   run only trusted code (e.g., code installed by an
│                       │      │                   administrator). CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Confidentiality
│                       │      │                   impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to
│                       │      │                   exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with
│                       │      │                   network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle
│                       │      │                   Java SE.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can
│                       │      │                   result in  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to
│                       │      │                   some of Oracle Java SE accessible data as well as 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can only be
│                       │      │                   exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified
│                       │      │                   Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a
│                       │      │                   web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.8 (Confidentiality and
│                       │      │                   Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance TLS certificate handling (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JSSE).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via TLS to
│                       │      │                   compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or
│                       │      │                   delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data.
│                       │      │                   Note: This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in
│                       │      │                   the specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 3.7 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      │                   25.0.4.1 and  27. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read
│                       │      │                   access to a subset of Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data
│                       │      │                   to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such
│                       │      │                   as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.7

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance Network Clients (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Networking).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update,
│                       │      │                   insert or delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited
│                       │      │                   by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a
│                       │      │                   web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.7
│                       │      │                   (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance Template Handling (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JAXP).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update,
│                       │      │                   insert or delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited
│                       │      │                   by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a
│                       │      │                   web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.7
│                       │      │                   (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      │                   2D).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java
│                       │      │                   SE: 8u503 and  8u503-perf; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability
│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or
│                       │      │                   delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                    can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance MIDI file handling (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Sound).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   require human interaction from a person other than the
│                       │      │                   attacker. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can
│                       │      │                   result in unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of
│                       │      │                   service (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Note: This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                   clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. This vulnerability does not apply
│                       │      │                    to Java deployments, typically in servers, that load and
│                       │      │                   run only trusted code (e.g., code installed by an
│                       │      │                   administrator). CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.1 (Availability
│                       │      │                   impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjfx: openjfx: information disclosure via untrusted code
│                       │      │                   execution 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle JavaFX, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                   (component: JavaFX).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503; Oracle JavaFX: 21.0.12, 25.0.4
│                       │      │                   and  27; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1.
│                       │      │                   Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated
│                       │      │                   attacker with network access via multiple protocols to
│                       │      │                   compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle JavaFX, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks require human
│                       │      │                   interaction from a person other than the attacker.
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle JavaFX, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible
│                       │      │                   data. Note: This vulnerability applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run
│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and
│                       │      │                    rely on the Java sandbox for security. This vulnerability
│                       │      │                   does not apply to Java deployments, typically in servers,
│                       │      │                   that load and run only trusted code (e.g., code installed by
│                       │      │                    an administrator). CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.1 (Confidentiality
│                       │      │                    impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JSSE).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via TLS to
│                       │      │                   compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this

│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data.

│                       │      ├ Title           : OpenJDK: Distrust eMudhra intermediate CA certificates due
│                       │      │                   to security concerns 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JSSE).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u511-b32, 8u511-perf-b32, 11.0.33.0.2,
│                       │      │                   17.0.21.0.2, 21.0.13.0.2, 25.0.5.0.2, 27.0.1.0.2; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.2 and  21.0.13.0.2; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.2. Easily exploitable
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data as well
│                       │      │                   as  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access
│                       │      │                   to all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 9.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).

│                       │      │                   XSD-validated document 
│                       │      ├ Description     : A flaw was found in libxml2. This vulnerability occurs when
│                       │      │                   the library processes a specially crafted XML Schema
│                       │      │                   Definition (XSD) validated document that includes an
│                       │      │                   internal entity reference. An attacker could exploit this by
│                       │      │                    providing a malicious document, leading to a type confusion
│                       │      │                    error that causes the application to crash. This results in
│                       │      │                    a denial of service (DoS), making the affected system or
│                       │      │                   application unavailable.

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance PKCS5 padding (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Security).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;    Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1;   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability
│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 5.9 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Improve C2 loop transformations (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Compiler). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1 and  27. Difficult to exploit
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                    Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of
│                       │      │                   Oracle Java SE accessible data as well as  unauthorized read
│                       │      │                    access to a subset of Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data
│                       │      │                   to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such
│                       │      │                   as through a web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.8
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance SASL Authentication (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Security). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1,
│                       │      │                   25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and 
│                       │      │                   21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1.
│                       │      │                   Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated
│                       │      │                   attacker with network access via multiple protocols to
│                       │      │                   compromise Oracle Java SE.  Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or
│                       │      │                   delete access to some of Oracle Java SE accessible data as
│                       │      │                   well as  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java
│                       │      │                    SE accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be
│                       │      │                   exploited by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g.,
│                       │      │                   through a web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.8
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JDBC).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;    Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1;   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability
│                       │      │                   allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via
│                       │      │                   multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to
│                       │      │                   all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                   Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                    can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,
│                       │      │                   e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run
│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and
│                       │      │                    rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance XPath Expressions (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JAXP).  Supported versions that are affected
│                       │      │                   are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1,
│                       │      │                    21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1
│                       │      │                   and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                   21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or complete access to all Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited
│                       │      │                   by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a
│                       │      │                   web service which supplies data to the APIs. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in
│                       │      │                    clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or
│                       │      │                   sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code
│                       │      │                   (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the
│                       │      │                   Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.9
│                       │      │                   (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance HTTP Server (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Networking). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1 and  27. Easily exploitable
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                    Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                   accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can only be
│                       │      │                   exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified
│                       │      │                   Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a
│                       │      │                   web service. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.3 (Confidentiality
│                       │      │                   impacts).  CVSS Vector:

│                       │      │                   979d49a82a7 
│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance HTTP Client (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Networking). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily exploitable
│                       │      │                   vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network
│                       │      │                   access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                    Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of
│                       │      │                   Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can
│                       │      │                    be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,
│                       │      │                   e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance TLS handshakes (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: JSSE). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1,
│                       │      │                   25.0.4.1; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Easily
│                       │      │                   exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker
│                       │      │                   with network access via TLS to compromise Oracle Java SE. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in
│                       │      │                   unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service
│                       │      │                   (partial DOS) of Oracle Java SE. Note: This vulnerability
│                       │      │                   can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component,
│                       │      │                   e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs.
│                       │      │                    This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments,
│                       │      │                   typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start
│                       │      │                   applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run
│                       │      │                   untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and
│                       │      │                    rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score
│                       │      │                   5.3 (Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance jstatd (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: Serviceability).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503, 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple
│                       │      │                   protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for
│                       │      │                   JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks
│                       │      │                   of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update,
│                       │      │                   insert or delete access to some of Oracle Java SE, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition
│                       │      │                   accessible data as well as  unauthorized read access to a
│                       │      │                   subset of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 4.8 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts). 
│                       │      │                    CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance jmod handling (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in Oracle Java SE (component: Libraries). 
│                       │      │                   Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE:
│                       │      │                   8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1, 17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27;
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle
│                       │      │                   GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to
│                       │      │                   exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with
│                       │      │                   logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Java SE executes to
│                       │      │                    compromise Oracle Java SE.  Successful attacks require
│                       │      │                   human interaction from a person other than the attacker.
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in 
│                       │      │                   unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to
│                       │      │                   critical data or all Oracle Java SE accessible data. Note:
│                       │      │                   This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the
│                       │      │                   specified Component, e.g., through a web service which
│                       │      │                   supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies
│                       │      │                   to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS
│                       │      │                   3.1 Base Score 4.7 (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).

│                       │      ├ Title           : openjdk: Enhance JShell (Oracle CPU 2026-10) 
│                       │      ├ Description     : Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK,
│                       │      │                    Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE
│                       │      │                    (component: JDK tools).  Supported versions that are
│                       │      │                   affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u503-perf, 11.0.32.1,
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1, 21.0.12.1, 25.0.4.1, 27; Oracle GraalVM for JDK:
│                       │      │                   17.0.20.1 and  21.0.12.1; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition:
│                       │      │                    21.3.19.1.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows
│                       │      │                   unauthenticated attacker with logon to the infrastructure
│                       │      │                   where Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM
│                       │      │                    Enterprise Edition executes to compromise Oracle Java SE,
│                       │      │                   Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. 
│                       │      │                   Successful attacks require human interaction from a person
│                       │      │                   other than the attacker. Successful attacks of this
│                       │      │                   vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion
│                       │      │                    or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java
│                       │      │                   SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise
│                       │      │                   Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability applies to
│                       │      │                    Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed
│                       │      │                   Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that
│                       │      │                   load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the
│                       │      │                   internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. This
│                       │      │                   vulnerability does not apply to Java deployments, typically
│                       │      │                   in servers, that load and run only trusted code (e.g., code
│                       │      │                   installed by an administrator). CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.7
│                       │      │                   (Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector:
│                       │      │                   (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N).
